notes: The targeted Item 7 excerpt was empty, so scoring rests on Item 1 alone. The Biogen Foundation is mentioned only in general terms ('refocused our Biogen Foundation efforts in the communities where we operate'), with no specific programs, dollars or participants, so it was not scored as community investment. Several terms were excluded as traps: 'educate physicians' (marketing), 'analytics community' (internal HR), 'innovative' (own innovation), and biotech collaborations, licenses and the City Therapeutics convertible note (licensing or deal structures, not enabling founders). Patient-access programs (E4) are counted only under Cross-cultural as customer access, not under Community. Tuition reimbursement is part of employee benefits and is consistent with the employee-development cap.
